sentiment-24: Decide whether a brief product review reads as positive, negative or neutral.
tickets-40: Sort one customer support ticket into billing, bug, feature or other; when a ticket raises two topics, use the label of the main request.
invoice-40: From a plain-text invoice, pull out the vendor, the date in YYYY-MM-DD form, the printed total and each line item with its description, quantity and unit price. Leave any field that is not printed as null and never guess a value.
exam-clean-40: Read the attached exam page and pull out each printed question: its number, stem, the four choices A-D and the printed answer key. A page listing only answers is an answer key page with no questions.
exam-scan-40: From the attached scanned exam page, list every printed question with its number, stem, choices A-D and printed answer key. A page that only lists answers is an answer key page and has no questions.
digitizer-24: Convert an uploaded test page into an answer key: pull out the printed questions and keys, work out each answer again from its question, and flag each mismatch for review.
digitizer-multipage-12: Turn a multi-page uploaded quiz into an answer key: pull out the printed questions and keys, work out each answer again from its question, and flag each mismatch for review.
